tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Supplying and Erection of new 100KVA 33KV/433V Electrical Transformer to LLPS-2 plant of MCC water supply at Thumbe

itemList.description: Supply, erection, testing and commissioning of 100 KVA,33/0.433KV OCTC ONAN Copper owned transformer. Oil filling with cover on conservator, conservator with sump and drain plug, oil level indicator on conservator, thermometer pocket plug, air release plug on tank cover, lifting lugs for complete transformer, off circuit tap switch with key and lock, drain valve cum bottom filter valve, top filter valve, silica gel breather, base channels with towing holes, rollers, earthing terminals, rating and diagram plate, manufacturers logo, radiators, hv cable box, Iv cable box, inspection window, additional neutral bushing, explosion vent, marshelling box with wtiand Otland terminals. With CPRI test certificate
